newsitem.title: USA: Power Efficieny hires financial adviser.
newsitem.headline: Power Efficieny hires financial adviser.

text.p: Power Efficiency Corp said Tuesday it signed an agreement with McFarland Dewey & Co, a New York financial advisory and investment banking firm, to assist it in its corporate finance and mergers & acquisitions strategies.
Power Efficiency Corp designs, develops, markets and sells proprietary solid state electrical components which effectively reduce energy consumption in alternating current induction motors.
